page_title: Make your next ad.An idea in. A visual out.

sources.entry: Muse Studio - Generates static ad concepts from text with editable headline, offer and CTA, and PNG export. Limited free beta; ChatGPT sign-in; no card. #free #design

summary.name: Muse Studio
summary.one_liner: A web tool that generates a static social ad concept from a text brief, with editable headline, offer and button text, and PNG export at 1080 × 1350.
use_cases: Create a social ad concept for a product launch
Draft an artwork for a weekend offer
Promote a local event with a social post graphic
Edit headline, offer and button text on an ad visual
Download a 4:5 PNG for a social post
summary.what_it_does: Users describe what they sell, their offer and the mood in a text brief. After signing in with ChatGPT, the tool generates one new AI ad concept image from those words. The headline, offer and button text on the result can be edited, and the ad can be downloaded as a 1080 × 1350 PNG in 4:5 format. The page states that the AI invents the concept image and will not reproduce exact packaging or logos, and photo upload is not offered in this batch.
notable: Text-only brief generates an AI ad concept image with editable headline, offer and CTA
Exports a 1080 × 1350 (4:5) PNG for social posts
Sign-in with ChatGPT; no payment or card required
Text editing and example downloads are unlimited
caveats: Limited free beta: one AI generation per ChatGPT identity, with a total batch cap of 10 attempts, and failed requests count toward it
Photo upload not offered; AI will not reproduce exact packaging or logo
Generated results are private and downloadable for only 24 hours after request
